result_preview.description: This API resource exposes employee availability data and time-off records to manage sales team capacity and workload distribution. It provides access to real-time scheduling information, enabling sales managers to optimize resource allocation and plan territory assignments. The service manages both active employee calendars and approved leave periods to support accurate sales forecasting and opportunity assignment.
